secondWindow.note: Pre-registered before any keyed run: the 106 weekly returns immediately before the primary window, same estimator, same sample floor, same 400 placebo draws and seed. Replicates when mean out-of-sample ΔR² > 0 and placebo p ≤ 0.10 on that slice. The window is fixed here, not chosen after seeing results.

tasteSignal.note: Amended 2026-10-30, after the keyed pull and before any result was read. The pre-registered field was velocity_fold_change; measured on 140 cached trend pages it is 0 on 71 of the 106 primary-window weeks, the zero weeks are the same dates for every entity (Qloo's refresh cadence, not entity stillness), and it equals population_percent_delta on every point. population_percentile is the field that varies week to week, so the weekly taste return is ln(level_t / level_{t-1}), with a missing adjacent week producing no observation.

flagRule.description: Flag when cultural beta is negative, clears the |t| screen, and survives Benjamini-Hochberg across every priced name. A hundred tests at |t| >= 2 would flag about five names by chance, so the screen alone is not a flag.
